name: takeover request / transition demand issued
semantic_meaning: the system issues the request to resume the dynamic driving task (R157 §2.2 'transition demand')

name: driver acknowledgement / mode-switch action
semantic_meaning: an explicit driver action on the HMI signalling acceptance of the takeover (D003: mode-switch button)

name: authority transfer (per control channel)
semantic_meaning: the moment a human input takes priority over the automation on a given channel; for R157 systems: deactivation or override under §6.2.5 / §6.3
code_representation: authority switches to human at t_reaction; code docstring assumes T_authority = TOR

name: first human control input
semantic_meaning: first input by the human to steering, brake or accelerator, whatever its effect

name: first activity on a control channel
semantic_meaning: first change in a logged accelerator / brake / steering channel after TOR, regardless of author

name: effective human control
semantic_meaning: first human input that changes vehicle motion on a channel over which the human has authority
code_representation: brake command step at t_reaction; deceleration after t_reaction + t2

name: lane change
semantic_meaning: the vehicle crosses into the adjacent lane (validated against lane id)

name: handback to automation
semantic_meaning: the driver hands control back to the automation (protocol step; competing event / observation boundary)

name: hazard boundary reached
semantic_meaning: manoeuvre-specific boundary: braking - ego reaches the hazard station with v > 0; steering - ego reaches the hazard station with lateral overlap
d003_identifiable: PARTIAL (station crossing only; geometry unknown, B10)

name: minimum-risk manoeuvre starts
semantic_meaning: the system starts an MRM (R157: earliest 10 s after the transition demand without deactivation, or immediately on severe failure)

name: minimum-risk manoeuvre complete
semantic_meaning: the MRM ends: standstill reached or system deactivated (R157 00 series §5.5.2-5.5.4, OJ L 82; Rev.1 renumbers §5.5 and was not re-checked for these clauses)
